summary: Close the custom-reference fail-open path where a present runtime-policy marker with a malformed checksum token is mistaken for an absent policy and silently inherits the package default.
decisions: Detect policy-block presence by its namespace marker, independently of whether the checksum token satisfies the strict parser regex.
Permit package-default inheritance only when no runtime-policy namespace marker is present at all.
Keep exact checksum and payload parsing in extract_runtime_color_policy as the authority for present blocks.

gate_results.evidence: Replacing the first checksum character f with non-hex g made RUNTIME_POLICY_BEGIN_RE miss the present block, and load_runtime_color_policy(custom) silently returned inheritance.mode=package-default instead of raising.

risks: A broad substring check must not treat unrelated prose as a policy block; use the exact runtime-policy namespace marker prefix.
Default documents and truly policy-free custom card references must retain their current behavior.
next_action: Token Curator fixes marker-presence detection, adds malformed checksum token tests for custom references, reruns color/full gates, and publishes a new completion handoff.
